policies.businessActivities: Residential, commercial, industrial contractors/project, including associated civil works, office occupiers and property owners of vacant land.
policies.insuredContracts: All contracts on hand or commenced during the Period of Insurance
policies.excludedContracts1: Are those contracts that include any of the following activities, unless agreed to by the Underwriter via Endorsement, prior to commencement:
policies.excludedContracts2:
- Underpinning, underground, tunnelling, bridging and dam works; or
- Airside or rail works; or
- Demolition exceeding 20 metres in height: or
- Works exceeding 10 levels; or
- Works above the 26th Parallel South; or
- With a construction period exceeding eighteen (18) months ; or
- With a maintenance/defects liability period exceeding twelve (12) months; or
- Contract exceeds the Sum Insured specified against Cover Item 1 (a);
policies.excludedContracts3:
Underground means any contract where the majority of the work, and the completed structure, will be situated below ground level

Tunnelling means any contract involving the excavation of an artificial subterranean passage (e.g. for the purposes of roads and railways).

wordings.subject: Open Trench Limitation (100 metres)
wordings.content:
We will indemnify the Named Insured against Damage to incomplete Trenches being partially or completely excavated, with or without pipes, ducts, or cables laid therein prior to backfill and final compaction, but only up to a maximum length as shown in the Schedule either in one continuous section or in the aggregate.

We will not indemnify the Named Insured under this endorsement against:
(i)   The cost of rectifying any subsidence of completed backfill regardless of the cause.
(ii)  The cost of cleaning pipes, the ends of which have not been sealed by the end of each working day to prevent entry of water and/or debris.
(iii) The cost of rectifying displacement of pipes or ducts by water unless such pipes and ducts have been secured by the end of each working day by backfill places in a manner intended to counteract pipe buoyancy.

This Policy shall not apply to any liability for Damage arising out of the intentional destruction or removal of poured concrete, concrete block, mortar or pre-stressed structural concrete or other structures being either in part or in whole the Insured’s Products which are found to be Defective.

wordings.content:
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.

Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Rip & Tear Exclusion
wordings.content:
The following exclusion is added to this Policy:

This Policy shall not apply to any liability for Damage arising out of the intentional destruction or removal of poured concrete, concrete block, mortar or pre-stressed structural concrete or other structures being either in part or in whole the Insured’s Products which are found to be Defective.

For the purposes of this endorsement “Defective” means any of the Insured’s Products which upon testing by an accredited independent testing agency do not meet the contractual specifications or applicable safety regulations or building codes relating to compressive strength or other criteria required for the specific construction in which such materials are incorporated.

wordings.subject: Open Trench Limitation (100 metres)
wordings.content:
We will indemnify the Named Insured against Damage to incomplete Trenches being partially or completely excavated, with or without pipes, ducts, or cables laid therein prior to backfill and final compaction, but only up to a maximum length as shown in the Schedule either in one continuous section or in the aggregate.

We will not indemnify the Named Insured under this endorsement against:
(i)   The cost of rectifying any subsidence of completed backfill regardless of the cause.
(ii)  The cost of cleaning pipes, the ends of which have not been sealed by the end of each working day to prevent entry of water and/or debris.
(iii) The cost of rectifying displacement of pipes or ducts by water unless such pipes and ducts have been secured by the end of each working day by backfill places in a manner intended to counteract pipe buoyancy.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Heritage Clause
wordings.content:
Heritage (Modern Materials) Clause
The following clause is added to this Policy

In the case of Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has architectural features and/or structural materials possessing ornamental or historical character or for which the original materials are not available, reinstatement value is the cost necessary to replace, repair or restore the building to a reasonably equivalent appearance and capacity using modern materials.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal
wordings.content:
Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
The Underwriter will cover the Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal, which is in the care, custody or control of the Insured and for which the Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has been declared to the Underwriter and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
The underwriter will not indemnify the Insured against loss or damage to Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal in respect of ceiling, floor or wall finishes or coverings.
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Heritage Clause
wordings.content:
Heritage (Modern Materials) Clause
The following clause is added to this Policy

In the case of Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has architectural features and/or structural materials possessing ornamental or historical character or for which the original materials are not available, reinstatement value is the cost necessary to replace, repair or restore the building to a reasonably equivalent appearance and capacity using modern materials.

wordings.subject: Heritage Clause
wordings.content:
Heritage (Modern Materials) Clause
The following clause is added to this Policy

In the case of Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal that has architectural features and/or structural materials possessing ornamental or historical character or for which the original materials are not available, reinstatement value is the cost necessary to replace, repair or restore the building to a reasonably equivalent appearance and capacity using modern materials.

wordings.subject: Existing Property (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
wordings.content:
We will cover the Named Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Property, which is in the care, custody or control of the Named Insured and for which the Named Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Property that has been declared to Us and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
               
Supplementary Exclusion 
We will not indemnify the Insured against physical loss of, or damage caused by, arising out of, or in any way connected to:

1. pathways, driveways, outdoor paving, swimming pools, fencing, wall finishes or coverings, or any contents; and
2. the restumping, raising or lowering of any building of structure; and 
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Dewatering
wordings.content: We will not indemnify the Named Insured against any costs associated with the installation and operation of any dewatering equipment or any other costs.

wordings.subject: Existing Buildings or Structures of Principal (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
wordings.content:
We will cover the Named Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Property, which is in the care, custody or control of the Named Insured and for which the Named Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.

Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Property that has been declared to Us and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.

Supplementary Exclusion 
We will not indemnify the Insured against physical loss of, or damage caused by, arising out of, or in any way connected to:

1. pathways, driveways, outdoor paving, swimming pools, fencing, wall finishes or coverings, or any contents; and
2. the restumping, raising or lowering of any building of structure; and 

Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.content:
We will cover the Named Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Property, which is in the care, custody or control of the Named Insured and for which the Named Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Property that has been declared to Us and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
We will not indemnify the Insured against physical loss of, or damage caused by, arising out of, or in any way connected to:

1. pathways, driveways, outdoor paving, swimming pools, fencing, wall finishes or coverings, or any contents; and
2. the restumping, raising or lowering of any building of structure; and 
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.

wordings.subject: Existing Property (Static plus arising out of Contract Works)
wordings.content:
We will cover the Named Insured against sudden and unforeseen physical loss or damage, not hereinafter excluded, to Existing Property, which is in the care, custody or control of the Named Insured and for which the Named Insured have agreed to insure, occurring and discovered during the Construction Period.
 
Provided furthermore that indemnity will only be granted in respect of loss or damage to the Existing Property that has been declared to Us and noted in the Schedule and will not exceed the limit stated in the Schedule, less any applicable Excess/s.
 
Supplementary Exclusion 
We will not indemnify the Insured against physical loss of, or damage caused by, arising out of, or in any way connected to:

1. pathways, driveways, outdoor paving, swimming pools, fencing, wall finishes or coverings, or any contents; and
2. the restumping, raising or lowering of any building of structure; and 
 
Supplementary Condition
All roof and wall openings must be covered by properly fitted and secured tarpaulins outside of normal work hours.
